payload.body_they: {{Name}} needs their home life to reflect what they actually value, especially in the way affection, money, responsibilities, and private treatment are handled. They may show love through cooking, remembering what people like, keeping traditions, or making daily life more comfortable. The complication is carrying more and more simply because they care about how the home feels. A beautiful home is much less relaxing when they are the only person responsible for keeping it that way.
